Update a playlist item. Use this tool to update a playlist item.

Usage:
  yutu playlistItem update [flags]

Examples:
# Update playlist item title
yutu playlistItem update --id abc123 --title 'Updated Title'
# Update playlist item description and privacy
yutu playlistItem update --id abc123 --description 'New description' --privacy public
# Update playlist item privacy with JSON output
yutu playlistItem update --id abc123 --privacy private --output json

Flags:
  -d, --description string              Description of the playlist item
  -h, --help                            help for update
  -i, --id strings                      ID of the playlist item to update
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -o, --output string                   json|yaml|silent
  -p, --privacy string                  public|private|unlisted
  -t, --title string                    Title of the playlist item
      --yes                             Confirm the operation
